jobs.title: Head of Data Science - Trust and Safety
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The Trust & Safety Data Science team's mission is to provide strategic and analytical support that enables TikTok to be the most trusted platform for our users and creators. The team partners with various functions across the organization - including Policy, Risk Prevention & Response, and Transparency Reporting, among others - to drive operational excellence through data. Its charter is to establish shared success metrics, develop trusted insights, and enable strategic decision-making across the organization.

Responsibilities:
- Lead and define the global Data Science strategy for the Trust & Safety organization, ensuring alignment with business priorities and long-term company objectives.
- Build, develop, and lead high-performing teams of Data Scientists across multiple regions.
- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Policy, Operations and executive leadership to translate business challenges into scalable data-driven solutions.
- Define and evolve the organization's measurement framework, including north-star metrics, experimentation strategy, and operational KPIs.
- Drive the development of advanced analytics, machine learning, forecasting, and optimization models that improve Trust & Safety decision-making and operational effectiveness.
- Establish a strong data foundation by improving data quality, governance, observability, and measurement consistency across the organization.
- Deliver executive-level insights through clear storytelling, influencing strategic investments and business priorities.
- Champion an AI-first approach by identifying opportunities to leverage automation, GenAI, and predictive analytics across Trust & Safety workflows.
- Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning while attracting and developing world-class talent.
- Represent the Data Science organization as a trusted strategic partner across global cross-functional leadership teams.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s):
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- 5+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
- 5+ years of experience leading and developing global Data Science or Analytics organizations within a technology company.
- Demonstrated experience defining and executing organization-wide data strategies that influence product and business decisions.
- Strong expertise in statistical analysis, experimentation, machine learning, and large-scale data analytics.
- Experience working with large-scale distributed data platforms and modern analytical technologies (e.g., SQL, Python, Spark, Hadoop, cloud data platforms).
- Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts and analytical insights to executive leadership and influence strategic decisions.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
- Experience leading Data Science organizations supporting Trust & Safety, Integrity, Risk, Fraud, Security, or other large-scale online platform ecosystems.
- Experience building AI-powered decision systems, including predictive analytics, GenAI, or LLM-enabled products.
- Strong understanding of experimentation frameworks, causal inference, and large-scale measurement systems.
- Experience driving organizational transformation through data governance, observability, and operational excellence initiatives.
- Demonstrated success leading globally distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.
- Track record of influencing executives and driving company-wide strategic initiatives through data.
- Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Policy organizations to deliver measurable business outcomes.
- Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain world-class technical leadership talent.
- Passion for building safe, trustworthy, and responsible technology platforms.

Trust & Safety

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​
​
TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​
​
We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.​

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​

Job Information

The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $254800 - $504000 annually.​
Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​
Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).​

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer – National Security, Dock Subject Matter Expert
jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About The Role

Skydio is seeking a hands-on, customer-facing Solutions Engineer to serve as the Dock subject matter expert for our Federal and Defense customers. This is a technical role aligned to the sales motion, responsible for winning technical validation, deploying dock-based autonomous systems, and ensuring successful operation across compliant cloud and on-premise environments. You will partner with Federal Sales to lead technical discovery, validate deployment architectures, and prove system performance through demonstrations, proofs of concept, and field deployments, operating comfortably both in front of senior government stakeholders and alongside engineers and operators in field environments.

This is a remote role. Travel of 50 to 75% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events.

About The Team

The National Security Solutions Engineering team is the technical arm of Skydio's federal go-to-market motion. We sit between the customer and the product: translating mission problems into requirements, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are accredited, integrated, and flown at scale.

As Skydio advances toward large-scale dock deployments and browser-based remote operations, this seat is the bridge between customers and Skydio's Product and Engineering teams. The team is measured on technical win rate, evaluation and field trial outcomes, program expansion, and the quality of the requirements we push back into the product organization.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Account Executives, Program Management, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of federal sUAS programs.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Partner with Sales and Customer Success to win technical validation and define deployment success criteria, and serve as the Dock subject matter expert for autonomous systems operating in cloud and on-premise environments.
Lead demonstrations, proofs of concept, and field trials, including hands-on dock installation, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting, and ensure systems are installed, tested, and delivering value as agreed.
Design, deploy, and troubleshoot compliant cloud, on-premise, WiFi, cellular, and IP networking architectures, and build scalable deployment processes for dock installations on secure government networks.
Work the accreditation and compliance path these customers require: ATO processes, impact levels for cloud hosting, secure data handling, NDAA compliance, and Blue UAS Cleared List status.
Act as the customer's technical representative internally, coordinating with Product, Engineering, and Sales to resolve issues, and quantify product feedback into prioritized, defensible requirements.
Support customer onboarding, training, and early operational use to drive long-term adoption and expansion, and support executive briefings and customer reviews as required.

What Makes You a Good Fit

3+ years supporting cloud-connected or on-premise hardware and software systems.
Strong hands-on experience with WiFi, cellular, and IP networking, including troubleshooting connectivity issues, and familiarity with compliant cloud environments, on-premise deployments, and secure data handling.
Experience installing, configuring, testing, and maintaining hardware systems in customer environments, and familiarity with Linux-based systems and mechanical or robotic platforms.
Familiarity with government acquisition processes and the delivery of complex technical systems under contract.
Proven ability to implement new technology and coordinate with technical teams to deliver on customer schedules.
Strong written and verbal communication, with comfort presenting to customers and internal stakeholders.
Comfortable working outdoors, at height, and performing physical tasks including climbing ladders.

Nice to Have

Basic scripting or software integration experience, and working knowledge of REST APIs and customer integrations.
Experience with commercial or government autonomous aircraft systems.
Cloud or infrastructure certifications, or a degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience bridging operators and engineers, with credibility in both field deployments and technical discussions.

What Is Required

Active FAA Part 107 Certificate.
Ability to travel 50 to 75% of the time.
Ability to lift up to 60 lbs unaided.
Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance, or the ability to obtain one.
This role supports products our government customers and is subject to a government contract that requires Skydio to limit this position to candidates with U.S. Citizenship. We welcome every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States to apply. However, at this time, Skydio does not offer employment-based visa or permanent residency sponsorship for this role.

Compensation:
At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual salary range for this position is $150,000 - $225,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.

For positions located in the United States of America, Skydio, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit https://www.e-verify.gov/

jobs.title: Civil Engineer
jobs.description:
About Day And Zimmermann

No problem is too challenging or complex for Day & Zimmermann Maintenance and Construction (DZMC) because We do what we say! ® We’re here to make life easier for plant owners in the Power, Chemical, and Industrial markets. With our wide-ranging capabilities and long-standing industry experience, we deliver innovative solutions and seamless processes that effectively manage all aspects of the plant life cycle. It’s no wonder we’re the #1 maintenance services provider in the United States. Come join in on our purpose – We put people to work, we protect American freedoms, and we help our customer’s power and improve the world! https://www.dayzim.com/services-and-products/maintenance-construction

Opportunity Overview

Join DZMC Engineering
as a Civil Engineer 4
and contribute to innovative engineering projects that shape the communities and infrastructure of tomorrow. This role offers the opportunity to apply your technical expertise to medium-sized projects while working alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment.

You will perform advanced civil engineering analyses, develop practical and creative design solutions, and help move projects from concept through completion. Your work may include supporting project scopes, preparing engineering documents, evaluating design alternatives, and ensuring deliverables meet applicable standards, client expectations, and quality requirements.

As an integral member of the engineering team, you will collaborate with civil, structural, and other technical disciplines to deliver coordinated solutions that support successful project execution. Your knowledge, attention to detail, and commitment to technical excellence will have a direct impact on the quality and effectiveness of the work we provide to our clients.

D&Z values innovation, integrity, respect, and continuous learning. This is an exciting opportunity to expand your expertise, work on meaningful projects, and grow your career within a supportive team that recognizes the value of every contributor.

As the Civil Engineer 4, here is the work you'll do:

Provide comprehensive technical guidance and expertise within the civil engineering discipline, ensuring all elements of assigned projects meet and exceed industry standards.
Lead the development and continuous assessment of project scopes, proactively identifying scope changes and evaluating their impacts on timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.
Coordinate multidisciplinary design efforts seamlessly, fostering productive collaboration across various engineering specialties and client teams to ensure cohesive project outcomes.
Oversee quality assurance by meticulously reviewing design work and documentation to ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and constructibility requirements.
Assume responsibility for project deliverables by applying your Professional Engineer (PE) certification to stamp necessary project documents, demonstrating accountability and professional integrity.
Manage the administrative and supervisory aspects of assigned projects, including the formulation of staffing plans, budget oversight, and schedule adherence to guarantee successful project completion.
Mentor and support the growth of junior engineers and project team members, promoting a culture of knowledge sharing, professional development, and high performance.
This multifaceted role requires an individual who is both detail-oriented and visionary, capable of balancing technical precision with strategic project management to deliver exceptional engineering solutions.

This role is for you if you have these skills:

Demonstrated strong organizational capabilities adept at managing multiple concurrent projects, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met.
Broad and deep technical expertise within civil and structural engineering disciplines, enabling innovative problem-solving and informed decision-making.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills tailored to effectively engage with clients, multidisciplinary teams, and stakeholders at all levels.
Proven leadership abilities with experience supervising diverse teams, motivating individuals, and driving projects to successful completion.
Strong analytical skills supported by proficiency in modern engineering software and tools used for design, modeling, and project management.
Adaptability and resilience to navigate changing project environments and emerging challenges with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

And If You Have These Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering from an ABET-accredited institution or a qualification deemed acceptable by the State Board of Engineers for professional engineer licensure. A Master’s degree in Civil Engineering is highly preferred.
Minimum of 12 years of progressively responsible experience in civil engineering, demonstrating expertise in project execution, engineering best practices, and leadership within the field.
Current Professional Engineer (PE) license is required, underscoring your commitment to professional standards and ethical engineering practices.
Proven track record of successfully managing medium-sized projects, including budgetary oversight, scheduling, and staff management.
Familiarity with the latest codes, regulations, and industry trends relevant to civil engineering to ensure compliance and innovation.

In compliance with this state’s pay transparency laws, the salary range for this role is $114,960.00 - $172,440.00. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. (The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements).

We care about our employees and it shows.

Our staff receive a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical/Rx, dental and vision coverage; life, AD&D and disability insurance; flexible spending accounts; 100% paid maternity leave for up to 12 weeks, parental leave, family leave, other paid time off; voluntary benefits and discount programs to meet our employees’ individual needs including pet insurance for our furry family members!

Diversity, Inclusion & Equal Employment Opportunity

Day & Zimmermann is committed to maintaining an inclusive workforce, where employees are hired, retained, compensated and promoted based on their contributions to our Company. Our collective strength is rooted in over a century of diverse employees and businesses, commitment to success, and delivery on promises made. Federal and state Equal Employment Opportunity laws prohibit employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, veteran status and disability status. Day & Zimmermann is committed to providing an equal opportunity work environment in full compliance with these laws. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation in the application process, please email reasonableaccommodation@dayzim.com, and please specify which position you are interested in, including job title and location.

jobs.title: Part-Time Andrology Lab Technician
jobs.description:
Andrology Laboratory Technician | IVIRMA North America | Los Angeles, CA

Join IVIRMA North America, one of the nation's leading fertility care networks, as an Andrology Laboratory Technician
at our Los Angeles practice. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented science professional who is passionate about reproductive medicine and laboratory excellence. In this role, you will perform andrology laboratory procedures, process and analyze patient specimens, maintain accurate records, and support fertility assessments that directly impact patient care. Working alongside a multidisciplinary team, you will help ensure the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and compliance in a state-of-the-art laboratory environment. This is a part-time position, Monday through Friday from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM, with weekends as needed
, making it ideal for candidates seeking hands-on laboratory experience in a specialized and rewarding healthcare setting.

The Andrology Laboratory Technician follows the laboratory’s procedures for specimen handling and processing, reporting and maintaining records of patient test results. Attention to detail is essential with these duties. The Andrology Lab Tech will be responsible for serving patients by providing precise and accurate laboratory results for the purpose of infertility assessment and management. This role is responsible for performing Andrology and Endocrine laboratory services in accordance with the Laboratory Procedure Manual.

Essential Functions And Accountabilities

Maintains accurate and current records of patient reports and inventory.
Adheres to the laboratory’s quality control policies; documents all quality control activities, as well as all instrument and procedural calibrations and maintenance performed.
Follows the laboratory’s policies and procedures whenever test systems are not within the laboratory’s established, acceptable levels of performance.
Studies and remains current and knowledgeable with the Laboratory Operating Manual regarding quality assurance, quality control, safety procedures and operating guidelines for performing all assigned laboratory services.
Holds a comprehensive understanding of and follow all OSHA requirements for safe laboratory operations to maintain a safe laboratory environment.
Assures quality care by adhering to therapeutic standards; follows practice, physician and laboratory division philosophies, as well as standards of care set by the state and other governing agency regulations.
Works cooperatively with the Company multidisciplinary teams to provide good patient care and achieves the objectives and goals of the practice.
Maintains patient confidence and protect operations by keeping all patient and proprietary information confidential. Adheres to signed HIPAA Confidentiality Agreement.

Academic Training

Bachelor’s Degree in a chemical, biological, clinical laboratory science or related – required
Studies level: University Education (Bachelor's Degree)
Studies area: Chemical/Biological/Clinical Laboratory Science or other related field

Position Requirements/Experience

Minimum 6 months’ laboratory training towards degree or experience in a clinical or research lab – preferred

Technical Skills

Electronic Medical Records experience - preferred
Excel at Microsoft Office Suites (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook)
Ability to operate laboratory equipment, hormone analyzers and microscopes

IVI-RMA offers a comprehensive benefits package to all employees who work a minimum of 30 hours per week.

Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance Options
Retirement 401K Plan
Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
Company Paid: Life Insurance & Long-Term Disability & AD&D
Flexible Spending Accounts
Employee Assistance Program
Tuition Reimbursement

About IVIRMA Global

IVIRMA
is the largest group in the world devoted exclusively to human Assisted Reproduction Technology. Along with the great privilege of providing fertility care to our patients, IVIRMA embraces the great responsibility of advancing the field of human reproduction. IVIRMA Innovation, as one of the pillars of IVIRMA Global, is a renowned leader in fertility research and science. Check out our websites at: https://rmanetwork.com/ & https://www.ivirma.com/

EEO

“IVIRMA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: IVIRMA is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at IVIRMA are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion and/or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. IVIRMA will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. IVIRMA encourages applicants of all ages.”

This is a remote role. Travel of 50 to 75% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events.

About The Team

The National Security Solutions Engineering team is the technical arm of Skydio's federal go-to-market motion. We sit between the customer and the product: translating mission problems into requirements, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are accredited, integrated, and flown at scale.

As Skydio advances toward large-scale dock deployments and browser-based remote operations, this seat is the bridge between customers and Skydio's Product and Engineering teams. The team is measured on technical win rate, evaluation and field trial outcomes, program expansion, and the quality of the requirements we push back into the product organization.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Account Executives, Program Management, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of federal sUAS programs.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Partner with Sales and Customer Success to win technical validation and define deployment success criteria, and serve as the Dock subject matter expert for autonomous systems operating in cloud and on-premise environments.
Lead demonstrations, proofs of concept, and field trials, including hands-on dock installation, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting, and ensure systems are installed, tested, and delivering value as agreed.
Design, deploy, and troubleshoot compliant cloud, on-premise, WiFi, cellular, and IP networking architectures, and build scalable deployment processes for dock installations on secure government networks.
Work the accreditation and compliance path these customers require: ATO processes, impact levels for cloud hosting, secure data handling, NDAA compliance, and Blue UAS Cleared List status.
Act as the customer's technical representative internally, coordinating with Product, Engineering, and Sales to resolve issues, and quantify product feedback into prioritized, defensible requirements.
Support customer onboarding, training, and early operational use to drive long-term adoption and expansion, and support executive briefings and customer reviews as required.

What Makes You a Good Fit

3+ years supporting cloud-connected or on-premise hardware and software systems.
Strong hands-on experience with WiFi, cellular, and IP networking, including troubleshooting connectivity issues, and familiarity with compliant cloud environments, on-premise deployments, and secure data handling.
Experience installing, configuring, testing, and maintaining hardware systems in customer environments, and familiarity with Linux-based systems and mechanical or robotic platforms.
Familiarity with government acquisition processes and the delivery of complex technical systems under contract.
Proven ability to implement new technology and coordinate with technical teams to deliver on customer schedules.
Strong written and verbal communication, with comfort presenting to customers and internal stakeholders.
Comfortable working outdoors, at height, and performing physical tasks including climbing ladders.

Nice to Have

Basic scripting or software integration experience, and working knowledge of REST APIs and customer integrations.
Experience with commercial or government autonomous aircraft systems.
Cloud or infrastructure certifications, or a degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience bridging operators and engineers, with credibility in both field deployments and technical discussions.

What Is Required

Active FAA Part 107 Certificate.
Ability to travel 50 to 75% of the time.
Ability to lift up to 60 lbs unaided.
Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance, or the ability to obtain one.
This role supports products our government customers and is subject to a government contract that requires Skydio to limit this position to candidates with U.S. Citizenship. We welcome every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States to apply. However, at this time, Skydio does not offer employment-based visa or permanent residency sponsorship for this role.

Compensation:
At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual salary range for this position is $150,000 - $225,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.

For positions located in the United States of America, Skydio, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit https://www.e-verify.gov/

new_jobs.description:
About Day And Zimmermann

No problem is too challenging or complex for Day & Zimmermann Maintenance and Construction (DZMC) because We do what we say! ® We’re here to make life easier for plant owners in the Power, Chemical, and Industrial markets. With our wide-ranging capabilities and long-standing industry experience, we deliver innovative solutions and seamless processes that effectively manage all aspects of the plant life cycle. It’s no wonder we’re the #1 maintenance services provider in the United States. Come join in on our purpose – We put people to work, we protect American freedoms, and we help our customer’s power and improve the world! https://www.dayzim.com/services-and-products/maintenance-construction

Opportunity Overview

Join DZMC Engineering
as a Civil Engineer 4
and contribute to innovative engineering projects that shape the communities and infrastructure of tomorrow. This role offers the opportunity to apply your technical expertise to medium-sized projects while working alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment.

You will perform advanced civil engineering analyses, develop practical and creative design solutions, and help move projects from concept through completion. Your work may include supporting project scopes, preparing engineering documents, evaluating design alternatives, and ensuring deliverables meet applicable standards, client expectations, and quality requirements.

As an integral member of the engineering team, you will collaborate with civil, structural, and other technical disciplines to deliver coordinated solutions that support successful project execution. Your knowledge, attention to detail, and commitment to technical excellence will have a direct impact on the quality and effectiveness of the work we provide to our clients.

D&Z values innovation, integrity, respect, and continuous learning. This is an exciting opportunity to expand your expertise, work on meaningful projects, and grow your career within a supportive team that recognizes the value of every contributor.

As the Civil Engineer 4, here is the work you'll do:

Provide comprehensive technical guidance and expertise within the civil engineering discipline, ensuring all elements of assigned projects meet and exceed industry standards.
Lead the development and continuous assessment of project scopes, proactively identifying scope changes and evaluating their impacts on timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.
Coordinate multidisciplinary design efforts seamlessly, fostering productive collaboration across various engineering specialties and client teams to ensure cohesive project outcomes.
Oversee quality assurance by meticulously reviewing design work and documentation to ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and constructibility requirements.
Assume responsibility for project deliverables by applying your Professional Engineer (PE) certification to stamp necessary project documents, demonstrating accountability and professional integrity.
Manage the administrative and supervisory aspects of assigned projects, including the formulation of staffing plans, budget oversight, and schedule adherence to guarantee successful project completion.
Mentor and support the growth of junior engineers and project team members, promoting a culture of knowledge sharing, professional development, and high performance.
This multifaceted role requires an individual who is both detail-oriented and visionary, capable of balancing technical precision with strategic project management to deliver exceptional engineering solutions.

This role is for you if you have these skills:

Demonstrated strong organizational capabilities adept at managing multiple concurrent projects, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met.
Broad and deep technical expertise within civil and structural engineering disciplines, enabling innovative problem-solving and informed decision-making.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills tailored to effectively engage with clients, multidisciplinary teams, and stakeholders at all levels.
Proven leadership abilities with experience supervising diverse teams, motivating individuals, and driving projects to successful completion.
Strong analytical skills supported by proficiency in modern engineering software and tools used for design, modeling, and project management.
Adaptability and resilience to navigate changing project environments and emerging challenges with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

And If You Have These Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering from an ABET-accredited institution or a qualification deemed acceptable by the State Board of Engineers for professional engineer licensure. A Master’s degree in Civil Engineering is highly preferred.
Minimum of 12 years of progressively responsible experience in civil engineering, demonstrating expertise in project execution, engineering best practices, and leadership within the field.
Current Professional Engineer (PE) license is required, underscoring your commitment to professional standards and ethical engineering practices.
Proven track record of successfully managing medium-sized projects, including budgetary oversight, scheduling, and staff management.
Familiarity with the latest codes, regulations, and industry trends relevant to civil engineering to ensure compliance and innovation.

In compliance with this state’s pay transparency laws, the salary range for this role is $114,960.00 - $172,440.00. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. (The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements).

We care about our employees and it shows.

Our staff receive a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical/Rx, dental and vision coverage; life, AD&D and disability insurance; flexible spending accounts; 100% paid maternity leave for up to 12 weeks, parental leave, family leave, other paid time off; voluntary benefits and discount programs to meet our employees’ individual needs including pet insurance for our furry family members!

Diversity, Inclusion & Equal Employment Opportunity

Day & Zimmermann is committed to maintaining an inclusive workforce, where employees are hired, retained, compensated and promoted based on their contributions to our Company. Our collective strength is rooted in over a century of diverse employees and businesses, commitment to success, and delivery on promises made. Federal and state Equal Employment Opportunity laws prohibit employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, veteran status and disability status. Day & Zimmermann is committed to providing an equal opportunity work environment in full compliance with these laws. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation in the application process, please email reasonableaccommodation@dayzim.com, and please specify which position you are interested in, including job title and location.
